name: gdpr-eu-sample
title: EU GDPR (sample pack)

controls.person: Tell people what you hold, why, on what basis and for how long, when you collect it (a privacy notice)
Have a contract with every processor: hosting, email, AI and other providers
Notify the supervisory authority of a personal data breach within 72 hours where required, tell the people affected when the risk to them is high, and keep a log of breaches
Assess high-risk processing before it starts (DPIA)
Appoint a data protection officer where required

notCovered: the right to object and to restrict processing (arts. 18 and 21)
rectification, where the app gives people no way to correct their data (art. 16)
